summary.en: A study found transgender people in Kashmir face family violence, school exclusion and workplace harassment. Officials seized land of five Pakistan-based militants in Reasi under UAPA for alleged militant funding. The Jammu Kashmir Police sanctioned Rs 5.5 lakh each to families of two SPOs killed in Kishtwar. Manipur police arrested seven KCP cadres, recovered arms, and the SS chairman of the banned UPPK was among eight militants nabbed in Manipur. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: En studie fant at transpersoner i Kashmir opplever familievold, skoleutestengelse og trakassering på arbeidsplassen. Myndighetene konfiskerte land til fem Pakistan-baserte militante i Reasi under UAPA for påstått finansiering av militante. Jammu Kashmir-politi godkjente Rs 5.5 lakh hver til familiene til to SPO-er drept i Kishtwar. Manipur-politi arresterte syv KCP-militære, gjenvant våpen, og SS-lederen for den forbudte UPPK var blant åtte militante som ble pågrepet i Manipur. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
